user_saw: Refreshing an unchanged base took longer because the sandbox received another full source snapshot, and small base advances consumed extra disk space.
summary: Guest base refresh now reuses source objects from host-approved snapshots and falls back to a full transfer when it cannot reuse them.
reasoning: The path history and introducing diff show that #174532 shipped base refresh with a full source pack on every completed refresh, even though the pack helper already supported retained snapshots. The PR reports successful refreshes with redundant transfer and storage costs, so this is a performance improvement to the original implementation.
